comments.author: @alvindurochermtl
comments.text: There is a simple reason why Gordon's dumpling didn't pass the head chef's scrutiny.  Dim Sum is predominantly a Cantonese or Southern Chinese cooking, and Southern Chinese cooking puts great emphasis on subtlety.  The roast duck in the dumpling predictably overwhelms both the subtle flavour and delicate texture of the shrimp and scallop.  That piece of garlic was also unnecessary and overkill for steamed dumpling.  It's all about balance.
